fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA).

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: The code of the branch where the loan is advanced

fields.name: REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: CUSTOMER ID
fields.description: Customer unique id linked to the Loan contract

fields.name: ACC LN NUMBER
fields.description: Unique number assigned to lndividual loan contracts

fields.name: BUSINESS ACTIVITY CODE
fields.description: The economic activity associated with the lending, as per ISIC guidelines.

fields.name: AGRIC ENTERPRISE CATEGORY
fields.description: This is a further classification for Agricultural "Business Economic Activties" classified further into either Small Scale Farm Enterprises and Large Scale Farm Enterprises, Agricultural boards and Cooperative Societies. If the above "business economic Activity code" is on Agriculture then this field should be mandatory.

fields.name: LOAN CATEGORY
fields.description: Secured or Unsecured

fields.name: LOAN PRODUCT TYPE
fields.description: The type of loan product granted

fields.name: LOAN DISBURSEMENT DATE
fields.description: Date when a loan is disbursed, including for mobile loans. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: LOAN DISBURSEMENT TIME
fields.description: Time when a loan is disbursed, including for mobile loans. Format {HH:MM:SS}

fields.name: LOAN DISBURSEMENT AMT FCY
fields.description: Approved/Disbursed loan amount in foreign currency.

fields.name: LOAN DISBURSEMENT AMT LCY
fields.description: Approved/Disbursed loan amount in the local currency equivalent.

fields.name: OUTS PRINCIPAL LN BAL FCY
fields.description: Outstanding Loan Principal Amount in foreign currency.

fields.name: OUTS PRINCIPAL LN BAL LCY
fields.description: Outstanding Loan Pricipal Amount in local currency equivalent.

fields.name: OUTS INT AMT DUE FCY
fields.description: Interest Amount in the foreign currency.

fields.name: OUTS INT AMT DUE LCY
fields.description: Interest Amount in the local currency equivalent.

fields.name: OUTS PENALTY INT AMT DUE FCY
fields.description: Penalty Interest Amount in foreign currency.
fields.payload_key: OUTS PENALTY INT AMT DUE FCY

fields.name: OUTS PENALTY INT AMT DUE LCY
fields.description: Penalty Interest Amount in the local currency equivalent.
fields.payload_key: OUTS PENALTY INT AMT DUE LCY

fields.name: TOTAL OUTSTANDING LN AMT FCY
fields.description: Total outstanding loan amount in foreign currency.

fields.name: TOTAL OUTSTANDING LN AMT LCY
fields.description: Total outstanding loan amount in the local currency equivalent.

fields.name: PRINCIPAL AMOUNT ARREARS FCY
fields.description: Principal amount in arrears in foreign currency.

fields.name: PRINCIPAL AMOUNT ARREARS LCY
fields.description: Principal amount in arrears in the local currency equivalent.

fields.name: INTEREST AMOUNT ARREARS FCY
fields.description: Interest amount in arrears in foreign currency.

fields.name: INTEREST AMOUNT ARREARS LCY
fields.description: Interest amount in arrears in local currency equivalent.

fields.name: INTEREST SUSPENSE FCY
fields.description: Suspended interest in the currency of disbursement {Accrued interest on non- performing loans that is not recognized as income in the institution's income statements}.

fields.name: INTEREST SUSPENSE LCY
fields.description: Suspended interest in the local currency equivalent {Accrued interest on non-performing loans that is not recognized as income in the institution's income statements}.

fields.name: SPECIFIC PROVISIONS LCY
fields.description: Amount of provisions held for the loan contract

fields.name: LOAN PERFORMANCE CLASS
fields.description: Normal, watch, substandard, doubtful and loss classification as CBK's prudential guidelines.

fields.name: PERF CLASS LAST MODIFIED DATE
fields.description: The date of last amendment of "performance classification'. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}.

fields.name: LOAN TENURE
fields.description: The loan repayment period for the facility based on the repayment frequency.

fields.name: ANTICIPATED MATURITY PERIOD
fields.description: The anticipated maturity period. E.g. Matured, 0-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, 91-180 days, 6-9 months, 10- 12 months, 1-3 years, 3-5 years and over 5 years.

fields.name: BASE RATE
fields.description: The reporting institution's base or reference rate.

fields.name: OVERALL INTEREST RATE
fields.description: The overall prevailing interest rate for the credit facility.

fields.name: INTEREST CALCULATION METHOD
fields.description: The method used to calculate interest e.g. {Fixed flat rate, Reducing balance or Reducing balance (with equal installments).

fields.name: LOAN APPLICATION FEE
fields.description: Loan application fees charged.

fields.name: LOAN ADMINISTRATION FEE
fields.description: Cumulative annual loan maintenance/administrative charges.

fields.name: OTHER LOAN CHARGES
fields.description: Other annual cumulative loan charges (apart from above).

fields.name: ANNUAL PERCENTAGE RATE
fields.description: The calculated annual percentage rate.

fields.name: LOAN REPAYMENT FREQUENCY
fields.description: Loan frequency {e.g. Daily, Weekly, Fortnightly), Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-annually, Annually, Tri-annual (3 times in a year), Bi-annual (Once in 2 years), Bullet payment etc}.

fields.name: LOAN INSTALMENT AMOUNT
fields.description: Equated Monthly Instalment (EMI) Amount. The scheduled loan installment amount

fields.name: TOTAL LOAN REPAID AMOUNT
fields.description: The amount of loan repaid, composed of principal and interest components.

fields.name: TOTAL INSTALMENTS PAID
fields.description: Due and paid loan installments.

fields.name: ARREARS START DATE
fields.description: The date when the arrears start in the format {DD- MMM-YYYY}.

fields.name: INSTALMENTS ARREARS
fields.description: Due and unpaind loan installments.

fields.name: MORATORIUM PERIOD
fields.description: Grace period on repayment in days.

fields.name: MORATORIUM ITEM
fields.description: The tem on which a grace period (moratorium), either on Principal or Interest
